CA.rationale: Content identified for candidate node and a processing-origin ('command_estimate') is explicitly linked to that same referent/time.

COD.rationale: Content coordinates (red) and an explicit origin/status string coexist for the same referent/time, satisfying C, O and D.

A.rationale: A processing-origin ('command_estimate' / feedback) is explicitly tied to the candidate content's representation.

C.rationale: Multiple lines explicitly identify content items (red/blue cell sets) with referents and attributes.

D.rationale: Origins/status metadata (copied_prior_record, command_estimate, history_estimate) are provided separately from content coordinates.

O.rationale: The report enumerates organized spatial patterns (cell sets) and labels them per node/time, describing representation/presentation structure.
